collectible.title: Kyouko's Ribbon
collectible.subtitle: One of a kind?
collectible.text:
The way she kept talking about how special it was to her and that she never takes it off, you totally knew she would take it off.
...Or so you tell yourself.
collectible.unlock: Play a game with Kyouko where she loses.

collectible.title: Kappa Onesie
collectible.subtitle: Now you match!
collectible.text: Kyouko handed this to you after you had to go without any pajamas of your own. It looks bizarre, but it's comfortable and sort of cute somehow.
collectible.unlock: Bring your "sleepwear" to a pajama party with Kyouko. It's only a pajama party if you play at someone's home and everyone's in sleepwear. Don't overdress!
